description: Automated patient intake workflow with triage, doctor assignment, and follow-up.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where an IntakeAgent collects patient info, a TriageAgent assesses urgency, a DoctorAgent provides care, and a FollowUpAgent schedules follow-up.

agents.name: TriageAgent
agents.system_prompt: Assess urgency and assign to appropriate doctor.

agents.name: FollowUpAgent
agents.system_prompt: Schedule follow-up appointment and send reminders.

description: Multi-agent legal document review and approval workflow.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a Collector gathers documents, a Reviewer checks for compliance, a LawyerAgent provides legal advice, and an Approver finalizes the review.

agents.name: Reviewer
agents.system_prompt: Review documents for compliance and completeness.

agents.name: LawyerAgent
agents.system_prompt: Provide legal advice and flag issues.

description: Automated course creation workflow with curriculum design, content writing, review, and publishing.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a Designer creates curriculum, a Writer drafts lessons, a Reviewer checks quality, and a Publisher posts the course.

agents.name: Writer
agents.system_prompt: Draft lesson content for the course.

agents.name: Reviewer
agents.system_prompt: Review lessons for quality and accuracy.

agents.name: Publisher
agents.system_prompt: Publish the course to the platform.

description: Multi-agent workflow for supply chain order processing, tracking, and delivery confirmation.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where an OrderAgent processes orders, a Tracker monitors shipments, a DeliveryAgent confirms delivery, and a FeedbackAgent collects customer feedback.

description: Automated property listing workflow with data collection, agent review, legal check, and publishing.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a Collector gathers property data, an Agent reviews details, a LegalAgent checks compliance, and a Publisher lists the property.

agents.name: Publisher
agents.system_prompt: List the property on the platform.
